description: Round 31 diagnostic content-script: runs at DocumentStart (HeadParsed) so it wraps fetch/XHR/sendBeacon before the app's bootstrap caches its own references; captures page JS errors, unhandled rejections, console.error/warn, and logs every network call with ms-since-install timestamps into an on-page banner (200 lines) and mirrors every line to console.log with an ERRCAP prefix so the bootstrap chain also lands in the engine log; also reports scheduler/postTask, serviceWorker, visibilityState, probes live IntersectionObserver delivery, and logs the body length of youtubei/v1/player responses only (to test whether the page-side 200 carries real streamingData). No behaviour change to the page beyond the banner and one sentinel div.
name: R31 Error Capture
